sentences: This legendary Indiana Jones scene only exists because Harrison Ford was *sick*.
In the script, Indy was supposed to fight this swordsman in a huge, *epic* whip battle.
A long, exhausting fight, in the *brutal* Tunisian heat.
But on shooting day, Harrison Ford had *dysentery*. He was sweating, exhausted, and could barely even *stand*.
So he looks at *Spielberg* and goes, why don't I just *shoot* him?
And when audiences saw it in theaters? They *lost* it.
It became one of the most *iconic* moments in movie history.
